text_block_list.text:
One day, shortly before the Kyodo News Hai,
the two of us were scheduled for a magazine interview.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Once again, we'd love to hear from both
Mr. C.B., who is currently in peak form,
and her Trainer today!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: Well then, looking forward to working with you!
The interview proceeded harmoniously without any issues, and—

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
And finally,
we would like to ask your Trainer a question.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
"It's been about a year since you two began running together.
Trainer, what kind of person is Mr. C.B. to you?"
I look back on this past year.
"My days in the Twinkle Series began, inspired by the dream of seeing her run. At first, I was often bewildered by her free-spirited nature, but—"

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: —Ahaha, well? Isn't it amazing!
That's precisely why they showed me so many sights I could never have seen alone.

Her boundless freedom, unbound by common sense...
That is who she is, and her greatest charm.
choice_data_list: She's the Uma Musume who broadened my world

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
I see...! With a bond of trust like that between you two heading into the Classic year...
I can't wait to see your future success!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
And finally, C.B.-san.
Could you give us a few words about your enthusiasm going forward, please!

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: ...Huh.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Ah, yes! Um—
Mr. C.B. was looking visibly shaken, which was rare for her. And on the way home that day—after remaining completely silent, she quietly murmured something.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: There's something I want to promise you.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. ...But before that, just for a bit.
Let me tell you my story.
After staring straight ahead for a moment, Mr. C.B. began to speak quietly.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"...Me being so carefree and doing whatever I want
never really brought anything good to those around me."

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Especially when it came to racing.
I was constantly letting down or angering the people who mentored me.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"Still, just trying to run the way I was told
didn't make it fun at all."

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"If I do that, running loses its meaning.
At least, for me."

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"That's why I decided not to listen.
No matter what happens, I'm going to run true to my heart."

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: I won't let anyone take it away, you know?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
...Still, I'm only human, you know.
There was just one thing I cared about.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
...Rudolf is fighting for the
happy days of all Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Symboli Rudolf
text_block_list.text:
To guide all Umamusume toward happiness,
I need the power to move many.
For that reason, I must reign at the very pinnacle.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Even Maruzensky is changing, wanting to leave behind more brilliant races for her juniors.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Besides, I get it now too.
That feeling of wanting to set an example
for your cute underclassmen.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Still, I'm... different.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I can admire it. But that doesn't mean
I want to do it myself.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I don't feel sad about not being able to feel that way,
nor do I want to change it.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: When you look at yourself objectively like that—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
I felt like something important
was missing.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: That's why I'm telling you, I can't run for anyone else's sake.
—Suddenly, I recall the expression I saw that day.
Come to think of it, that happened right after Symboli Rudolf and Maruzensky stepped away to guide their juniors.
I finally understood the meaning behind that gaze.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: They won't notice. I haven't told them, after all.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"If anything, I'm grateful.
To you, that is."

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
In front of my parents,
you praised my sense of freedom.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
And today, she told me again
that I'm broadening your world.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Do you have any idea... just how much courage
that gave me?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Come to think of it, it wasn't just today. It had been this way ever since we signed our contract.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Back then, I thought it was just because our interests aligned,
but I'm sure that wasn't
the only reason I chose it.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: ...If I run, will that let you dream?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"...That's amazing.
You really say some incredible things."

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Just knowing that you dreamed of seeing me run freely
made me genuinely happy from the bottom of my heart.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: None other than you, her "Trainer."

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
It's not an exaggeration. From now on, surely and always...
what you gave me will keep burning at the center of my heart.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
That's why... I want to make a promise.
I'm not usually a fan of doing this, you know? But just one, as a special exception.

—And Mr. C.B. directed
her gaze straight toward me.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
No matter what happens,
I'll keep on being the Mr. C.B. you dream of.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: I promise.

—From those few murmured words,
a resolve stronger than ever before could be felt.
